stem.text: Which is the correct sequence for the opening of the valves in the mammalian heart during one cardiac cycle?

A.alt: Flowchart of valve names joined by downward arrows: right atrioventricular valve, pulmonary semilunar valve, left atrioventricular valve, aortic semilunar valve.

B.alt: Flowchart of valve names joined by downward arrows: left atrioventricular valve, aortic semilunar valve, right atrioventricular valve, pulmonary semilunar valve.

C.alt: Flowchart of valve pairs joined by a downward arrow: left atrioventricular valve and aortic semilunar valve, then right atrioventricular valve and pulmonary semilunar valve.

D.alt: Flowchart of valve pairs joined by a downward arrow: left atrioventricular valve and right atrioventricular valve, then aortic semilunar valve and pulmonary semilunar valve.
